content:
Rina (CS): Quick runbook drop — tiny checklist CS can use for choppy demos: 1) Enable tenant prefill 3m prior, 2) Turn on 2-token streaming heartbeat, 3) If tenant has heavy prompts, force warm-pool. Thoughts?

Omar (SRE): +1. Add cap: max 5 concurrent prefill jobs per region. Emit prefill.job.failure metric.

Kei (Eng): Recommend TTLs: tenant-cache 45s, region-cache 3m, warm-pool 8m. Also add a personalization detector (prompt tokens+vars) -> mark warm-pool.

Lina (Solutions): CS copy for kickoff: "We run a short warm prefill to make responses snappier. If you use custom prompts we reserve a warm pool to preserve accuracy."

Customer-PM: Pilot looked smoother. One ask: can prefill run in sanitized-mode to avoid real PII?

Omar (SRE): We'll add sanitized boolean to prefill and tag metrics. Also ops alert if prefill fails 3x in 10m -> #customer-success-escalations.

Rina (CS): Great, I'll add this to the CS modal checklist and collect post-demo 1-question pulse (snappy? y/n).

Kei (Eng): I'll open a small PR for rate-limits + fallback cache logic.

Rina (CS): Thanks team — will trial with 5 more accounts and share results.
